//: Build profiles for EAS, which is how this becomes an app you install
rather than something running inside Expo Go.
Expo Go is the fastest way to see the product and it is not the product:
it cannot carry a custom bundle identifier, it shares one push
certificate, and from SDK 53 it no longer delivers remote notifications
at all. Anything being judged on how it feels on a phone wants `preview`.
None of these have been run — there is no Expo account attached to this
repository, and a build needs one. They are written to the documented
schema and are a starting point, not a verified pipeline.

development.//: A dev client: your own binary, still loading JS from Metro. Use this when you need a native module Expo Go does not carry.

preview.//: The one to hand somebody. A real installable build with the JS baked in: an .apk on Android, and TestFlight or an ad-hoc .ipa on iOS.

preview:simulator.//: Same as preview but for a Mac simulator, which needs no signing certificate and no device UDIDs.

production.//: Store builds. autoIncrement so two submissions never collide on a build number, which the stores reject.
